description: Free. Check whether agents can discover and call a public website. Fetches discovery files, follows MCP links named by those files, and runs only initialize, tools/list, and one unknown-tool call. Never executes a real tool. Returns a 0-100 score, every check with an evidence URL, and the top fixes. No license.

host.description: Public host to score, for example example.com

name: check_agent_readiness
